steps.code:
# Store the list of files and create notes for all except the one already created
files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='/home/glen/documents/personal/simple_note/', entry_type='files', recursive=False)
print(f"Total files: {len(files)}")
# We already created note for Book_Reading_Lists.md, so we'll skip it
for file_path in files:
    if file_path.endswith('Book_Reading_Lists.md'):
        continue
    # Derive title: basename without .md, replace underscores with spaces
    basename = file_path.split('/')[-1]  # e.g., "Food_Recipes.md"
    title = basename[:-3].replace('_', ' ')  # remove .md and replace underscores
    # Read content
    file_info = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=file_path)
    content = file_info['content']
    # Create note
    result = apis.simple_note.create_note(title=title, content=content, access_token=sn_token)
    print(f"Created note for {basename}: {result}")
